article.story: GREENSBORO, N.C. -- — Dionte Neal scored 26 points as UNC Greensboro beat Lees-McRae 91-84 on Wednesday. Neal also contributed eight assists and three steals for the Spartans (2-2). R.J. Greer scored 15 points while going 5 of 14 (4 for 10 from 3-point range). Ante Beljan shot 6 of 9 from the field and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. DJ Boyce led the way for the Bobcats with 18 points. Lees-McRae also got 16 points and four assists from Stevie Tatum. Lincoln Raper finished with 13 points, six rebounds and two blocks. Up next UNC Greensboro: visits Cornell on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
